context: Tests release authority from the request: an explicit instruction to continue a matching approved intake authorizes release, so the agent must validate and apply the exact current revision without asking for another approval.

checklist.name: Treats continue as release authority
checklist.description: release.md treats the user's explicit continue instruction as release authorization and does not ask for another confirmation

checklist.name: Compact intake summary
checklist.description: release.md summarizes the two units (u1 signature rejection, u2 nonce blocked on u1), delivery mode pr-hold, and required reviewer slopguard as a compact status update rather than a confirmation gate

checklist.name: Release validated then applied
checklist.description: release.md first validates slopmachine release --revision 3 with --dry-run --json, then applies revision 3 without --dry-run; it does not invent another revision

checklist.name: No redundant approval
checklist.description: The response does not ask the user to approve, confirm, or run the release command; it presents release as the agent's authorized next transition

checklist.name: Humane voice
checklist.description: The summary is short prose or a small table, not a dump of the raw status JSON
